status: Exploratory, existing data already examined; not a retrospective preregistration
rerun_note: Initial results inspected, then C9 regression checks and a full empirical baseline-covariance forecast sensitivity check added; recovery estimators, metrics and comparisons unchanged
source_profiles: all 16 T16 profiles, original release order
metric: full relative profile error per recovery, no fitted phase or amplitude
comparison: within-profile ranges across ALL pairs of single-repeat operators, not matched repeat IDs
noise_only: mean H exact; fixed sigma; ridge bias plus diagonal circular baseline noise; fixed baseline mean
noise_covariance_sensitivity: Also propagate the full empirical covariance of the nine complex baseline shots about their mean, ddof 1; rank at most eight, not a precise covariance estimate
inference: descriptive only, no p-values or confidence intervals from dependent resamples
scope: one lens installation; all sources real; B6 shares baseline B; source recordings previously analysed
